source_binding: Final checks bind the committed Go source and contract document. Each command records exact dirty inputs, output, timestamps, and terminal status.
limits: This commit adds an opt-in private record publication and recovery API. Runtime evidence and GitHub discovery callers still use the ordinary writer. Their integration and production startup recovery remain incomplete.

The fail-before API bridge delegated publication to the existing writer and provided no recovery. The prepared process-exit case failed because the temporary file remained. Two failed events include its parent. The replacement publication case passed before the implementation.

Nine process-exit scenarios cover new and replacement destinations, complete header, empty file receipt, partial bytes with a complete receipt, and incomplete ownership. Incomplete receipts preserve their staging files.

Before-publication and restart checks cover changed bytes, identities, access, timestamps, journal encoding, metadata directories, and writer locks. Active writers, unknown files, cancellation, scan limits, ambiguous flush, and retry have separate checks.

The writer uses a private .record-publications directory with a stable .owner.lock and bounded append receipts. Recovery scans at most 4096 metadata entries in batches of 128. Each receipt permits three events within 65536 bytes. Record data has a 64 MiB limit.

Native identities and access snapshots bind directory, writer, journal, and temporary-file ownership. Record receipts also bind mode, modification time, size, and digest. Recovery never deletes accepted destinations.
The first prose check crossed the missing KiB glossary threshold. The contract now states the exact byte limit. The second prose check found one passive sentence, which the final wording corrects.
Race tests run natively on macOS. Linux and Windows AMD64 compilation does not qualify native execution. Test-event counts include parent tests.
Consumer dependency gates pass with the existing platform limits and forbidden dependencies unchanged.
Generation retention, acquisition history compaction, twelve mapped subcases, full task verification, pre-PR review, native CI, and merge remain open.
Checks use the observed concurrent tooling graph. Those files remain archived outside this catalog commit. Full task qualification must use the final committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.
The first canonical prose check found one passive sentence and one nominalization. Corrected text passes. Both checks and their exact source snapshots remain archived.
